name: オイスター&スモークドバー サンゴ (Oyster & Smoked BAR SANGO)

claims.text: Izakaya-style oyster and smoked dishes here are typically seasoned with standard Japanese soy sauce, which contains wheat; no wheat-free seasoning is advertised.
The kitchen smokes and fries seafood, bacon, and cheese on shared equipment, so any vegetable item would share surfaces and oil with animal products.
Fresh fruit juices and Hiroshima-lemon lemonade/soda are fruit-based, giving plant-based and gluten-avoiding visitors a simple, naturally suitable option.
The signature anago rice is finished with a soy-sauce-based tare, which in standard Japanese preparation contains wheat.

name: らーめん 柿本 (Ramen Kakimoto)

claims.text: Kitchen is built around wheat ramen noodles, fried rice, and shumai; high likelihood of gluten cross-contact throughout. No gluten-free handling documented.
Broth is soy-sauce based; standard Japanese soy sauce contains wheat.
Meat-based broth and pork chashu; karaage and pork shumai also prepared in the same small kitchen, so vegan-safe preparation is not feasible.
The dandan sauce is a savory Sichuan-style seasoning typically built on soy/sesame-based components; no gluten-free preparation is documented, and the wheat noodles share the same kitchen.
The standard dandan noodles include minced meat, so vegan diners cannot rely on the regular dish; no separate vegan preparation is documented.
The restaurant specializes in sukiyaki, which is cooked in a warishita sauce based on wheat-containing soy sauce; no gluten-free version is mentioned.
Menu sets are centered on Hiroshima beef and include local egg and dashi-based broth, with no documented vegan or vegetarian alternative.
Sashimi, grilled and simmered seafood dishes at this izakaya are served with standard Japanese soy sauce, which is brewed with wheat.

name: ルーエ ぶらじる (Ruhe Brasil)

claims.text: Bread is baked on-site and toast, sandwiches, napolitan and gratin are core menu items, so wheat is pervasive in the kitchen; no gluten-free handling is documented.
Menu is built on eggs, dairy and meat (egg morning sets, gratin, napolitan, curry); no separate vegan preparation is documented.
